policies.title: Guyana: MFA and ISS aligned ordinary-passport visa exemptions
policies.summary: The current Foreign Ministry and Immigration Support Services schedules each name these nationalities without a special-passport or third-country-document condition. This is visa-free short entry, not a landing permit, eVisa or visa-on-arrival classification.
conditions: Only explicitly named, unqualified ordinary-passport entries in both current schedules are included.
The schedules give different permitted periods for some shared nationalities, including the Dominican Republic and Panama; no uniform duration is assigned.
CARICOM movement language, landing permits, and special-document routes are not normalized as this ordinary-passport visa exemption.

policies.title: Guyana: MFA-named ordinary-passport visa exemptions
policies.summary: The current Foreign Ministry schedule directly names these nationalities without a special-passport or third-country-document condition. Their absence from the ISS schedule is not treated as a contrary visa requirement.
conditions: Only the Foreign Ministry’s express unqualified entries are classified.
The classification does not convert CARICOM movement language, a landing-permit application, or a third-country-document condition into a visa exemption.

policies.title: Guyana: ISS and consular-schedule ordinary-passport visa exemptions
policies.summary: The current ISS schedule and official consular Schedule 1 directly name Lesotho and Malaysia without a special-passport or third-country-document condition. MFA omission is not treated as a contrary rule.
conditions: The ISS schedule gives Lesotho 14 days and Malaysia 60 days; no broader duration, passport type or purpose is inferred.
Only the explicit unqualified entries are classified.

policies.title: Guyana: Bolivian ordinary-passport tourist visa on arrival
policies.summary: ISS expressly identifies a tourist visa on arrival for Bolivian regular-passport holders. The official online process requires visa-on-arrival material and an approval letter before travel; the visa itself is issued at the port of entry, so this is not an eVisa.
conditions: The stated nationality route is limited to tourist entry with a regular passport.
Apply through ISS and obtain the emailed approval letter before travel; the immigration visa is issued at arrival.
This does not establish an electronic visa, walk-up visa without approval, work, residence, study, transit, diplomatic, official, service or special-document route.
No duration, port, entry-count, extension or fee is assigned beyond the reviewed guidance.

application.label: ISS visitor visa / visa-on-arrival approval application
steps: Submit the ISS visitor-visa application and its required supporting documents, including the mandatory visa-on-arrival request letter.
Travel only after receiving the ISS approval letter; present it so the visa can be issued at the Guyanese port of entry.

policies.title: Guyana: foreign ordinary-passport advance-visa complement
policies.summary: The Immigration (Passports) Order establishes this foreign ordinary-passport visa-required baseline. A situational ISS alternative is available where a visa-required-country national cannot apply at a Guyanese mission: approval is obtained before travel and the visa is issued at the port of entry, which is visa_on_arrival rather than eVisa.
conditions: This is the ordinary-passport nationality baseline. It does not guarantee admission or remove immigration-officer discretion.

The official ISS visa-on-arrival alternative is situational, not a nationality-wide baseline: the traveller must be unable to apply at any Guyanese diplomatic mission. Those able to use a mission obtain a consular visa before travel.

The statutory residual group excludes a scheduled passport country, a reciprocal visa-free Commonwealth route, an individual ministerial exemption, or a visa-abolition agreement in force. No unverified exception is assumed.

Guatemala, Honduras and Mexico have published U.S.-permanent-resident or valid U.S., Canadian or Schengen-visa alternatives. Those document- or residence-conditioned exceptions are preserved and do not make their ordinary nationality passports visa-free.
Diplomatic, official, service, special, crew, work, study, business, landing-permit, transit and existing-visa routes are outside this short-visitor ordinary-passport baseline.
For a qualifying ISS applicant, the approval letter is required before boarding and the visa is stamped and issued at arrival. Preapproval does not make the border-issued route an eVisa.

application.label: ISS conditional visa-on-arrival approval application
steps: Use this alternative only if unable to apply at a Guyanese diplomatic mission; submit the ISS visitor-visa application and required visa-on-arrival materials.
Carry the successful ISS approval letter for boarding; the visa is stamped and issued at the Guyanese port of entry.

unresolved.reason: The current MFA and ISS schedules state a Colombian ordinary-passport waiver, while the current Trinidad consular Schedule 1 restricts Colombia to diplomatic/service passports. The conflicting official ordinary-passport scope is held rather than resolved by source preference.

The current MFA and Trinidad consular schedules limit Cuba to diplomatic, official or service passports, while the current ISS schedule lists Cuba without that restriction. The ordinary-passport status is held unresolved.

The current MFA schedule limits Indonesia to diplomatic, official or service passports, while the current ISS and Trinidad consular schedules list Indonesia without that restriction. The ordinary-passport status is held unresolved.

The current MFA schedule limits Spain to diplomatic passports, while ISS and the Trinidad consular schedule list Spain without that restriction; the published Immigration (Passports) Order schedule also names Spain. The current ordinary-passport scope is held unresolved.

The current MFA schedule limits Uruguay to diplomatic or official passports, while ISS and the Trinidad consular schedule state a 90-day ordinary-passport waiver. The ordinary-passport status is held unresolved.
